purpose: Prospective feasibility audit for a geometry-bearing target-data adaptation experiment.

prior_pilot.relation_to_full_manifests: All 20 cases belong to the estate test split; none belongs to either training or validation split.
prior_pilot.policy: Exclude all 20 from every future confirmatory test. They remain development-only.

prospective_use.pilot: Use training subsets and validation splits only to choose optimization duration and estimate stochastic variance.
prospective_use.formal: Freeze nested training subsets and seed count before evaluating the 80 fresh estate test cases or any fastback test case.
prospective_use.primary_comparison: Within each architecture, compare source-pretrained adaptation with target-only training at the same target-example and optimization budgets.
prospective_use.architecture_question: Compare the pretraining benefit, not only absolute error, between the boundary-aware model and a strong generic operator.
